headline: Updates on food waste composting at the transfer station, textile collection, and a tire request for proposal.
summary: Food waste composting at the transfer station and textile collection will get updates. A tire request for proposal, Earth Day planning for 2027, and new youth and adult members are also on the agenda.

Executive session, if the town attorney recommends it

Textile collection: Alice Kosowsky to update on a meeting at the Rectory Barn with Bob Zoni of the Hamden Historical Society
Tire request for proposal: Joe DeRisi to update on recent Mayor's Office decisions

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
SOLID WASTE & RECYCLING 
COMMISSION 
 
REGULAR MEETING AGENDA 
 
7:00 PM, NOVEMBER 11, 2026 
 
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 
Meeting Agenda: The Solid Waste & Recycling Commission, Town of Hamden, will 
hold a Regular Meeting on Wednesday, November 11, 2026 at 7:00 PM in person at the 
Hamden Government Center, First Floor Conference Room. 
 
Meetings may be held virtually. 
If held virtually, you can access it via: 
Zoom link  https://hamden.zoom.us/j/87004765585 
OR 
Telephone  
+1 646 931 3860 US  | Webinar ID: 870 0476 5585  
1. CALL TO ORDER 
 
2. ATTENDANCE 
 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES 
 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT 
 
5. CORRESPONDENCE 
There will be a brief summary of the correspondence submitted between the last 
correspondence update and this one. This includes but is not limited to any 
correspondence with council members that members wish to submit for the record. It can 
also include written communication to the council from the administration, community 
members, etc.  
6. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney) 
7. REPORTS 
 
8. OLD BUSINESS 
 
  1. Food Waste Composting at the Transfer Station. Joe DeRisi, Recycling Coordinator, 
to report on regional and local events.
2. Textile collection. Alice Kosowsky, SW&R Chairperson, to update the Commission 
regarding meeting at the Rectory Barn with Bob Zoni from the Hamden Historical 
Society. 
  3. Tire Request for Proposal. Joe DeRisi to update on recent Mayor’s Office decisions. 
  4. Earth Day: brainstorming regarding central theme for 2027, involving other local 
groups. 
9. NEW BUSINESS 
 
  1. New Members, both Youth and Adult.  
  2. SCRCOG Meeting on 12/9/26, which happens to be SW&R Commission’s scheduled 
regular meeting. Vote on Commissioners’ preferences. 
10. ADJOURNMENT 
 
  
NOTE: The public may address any item on the agenda of a regular or special meeting and any 
matter within the purview of a Board or Commission at a regular meeting either electronically or 
in person, unless otherwise set forth or constrained by Law of the provisions of this Charter.
